integrity: Exact analytic proof of vertex-incidence path criterion and total unimodularity; independent Python exact arithmetic consistency checks on 26 small cases and 57 explicit witnesses. Finite tests do not constitute proof for unbounded dimension.
scientific_limitations: Integer s at least two, noncyclic path inequalities, both alternating first-edge orientations. No statement for s=1 or arbitrary weighted graphs. Complete latest preprint versions not exhaustively inspected; historical priority provisional.
title: A one-dimension smoothness gap for alternating adjacent-sum path polytopes
